build/sora_tmp/party/GOOFY/PLAN.md R8: amount = share x reference, so a reference equal to his own max HP gives no toughness

A hit on a friend, leading or not = its share of the Tarnished's max HP x incoming.reference_hp at his level x (incoming.reference_defense at his level / his status-screen Defense) ^ this. Sora's own rule (crates/kh-er sora.rs damage_in) is unchanged. 0 = no Defense term.

build/sora_tmp/party/GOOFY/PLAN.md R8: amount = share x reference, so a reference equal to his own max HP gives no toughness
true: Elden Ring's hits on a friend follow the rule above, so more HP and more Defense both make him last longer; false: a share of his own max HP (no toughness from either).
